title: Fuel for our outpost CLTV Outpost GSC-0044: 65 fuel cells bought at The Experiment, burnt into the tank at the outpost and the tank above 30 deposited into the faction's fuel reserve; members of the faction only
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-18 00:06 UTC (orders.log ENT-052, block APOLLO (1): keep the outpost's bunker filled by a route, not a hand; requests.log ENT-251, ENT-252, ENT-255). The bunker takes fuel only from a ship's tank (`deposit` item_id fuel, target faction); cells stored there stay items; a member's refuel there draws the reserve back for 0 cr (guidebook logistics.md section 15.3). The first fill by script: 1,292 fuel from 64 cells bought at 101 cr with the tax, about 5.1 cr a unit against 11 to 15 cr at our stations' tanks (2026-11-17 20:39 to 21:17 UTC). The step `bunker` of route_run.py (commit 85b14c83) burns whole cells into the tank's room and deposits the tank above `keep`, one call each, until no cell is left. The reserve read 1,258 of 50,000 at 23:52 UTC. A budget, not a loop: `once` with `max_pilots` 3 is three runs in all, about 4,000 fuel for about 20,000 cr; its Admiral raises max_pilots each turn by what the reserve's draw asks, until a dispatcher gate on the reserve stands (requests.log). Only in the rows of haulers seated in the faction (table faction_members): the outpost docks members only.
